children: NORTH EUROPEAN OIL ROYALTY TRUST reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $2.64M and diluted earnings per share of $0.27, largely in line with the prior-year quarter as net income edged up slightly to $2.47M.
Revenue: $2.642M for 3Q 2026, up from $2.617M in 3Q 2025 (0.9% YoY).
Net income: $2.474M for 3Q 2026, versus $2.459M in 3Q 2025 (0.6% YoY).
Diluted EPS: $0.27 for 3Q 2026, unchanged from $0.27 in 3Q 2025 (0% YoY).
Royalty income rose 29.4% year-to-date, driven by the absence of a prior negative adjustment and higher sulfur prices boosting receipts.
Channel mix shifted toward natural gas, which comprised roughly 89% of quarterly royalties; sour gas (about 75% of production) requires processing at the Grossenkneten plant.
Operator EMPG plans no new wells in 2026, focusing on maintenance, well workovers and small stimulations to sustain output.
The Grossenkneten processing plant has a scheduled ~50-day maintenance shutdown in Aug–Sep 2026, which is expected to temporarily reduce gas production.
Royalties are paid in euros and are exposed to GBIP-based pricing and EUR/USD rates, which affect USD distributions to unit owners.
